The team was led by head coach [[Tony Bennett (basketball)|Tony Bennett]] in his 12th year and played their home games at [[John Paul Jones Arena]] in [[Charlottesville, Virginia]], as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC). In a season limited by the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], they finished the season 18–7, 13–4 in [[2020–21 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]], to win their fifth regular season championship in eight seasons. They defeated [[2020–21 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2021 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] before they were forced to withdraw from the tournament due to COVID-19 issues. They received a bid to the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 4 seed in the West region. They were upset in the first round by [[2020–21 Ohio Bobcats men's basketball team|Ohio]]. == Previous season == The [[2019–20 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|Cavaliers]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 23–7, 15–5 in [[2019–20 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]], to finish in a three-way tie for second place. The team was scheduled to play [[2019–20 Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball team|Notre Dame]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2020 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] before the
